compute_projections_3d_points: project 3D points into multiple camera views using intrinsics and extrinsics matrices
compute_angle_ray_directions: compute the angle difference and inner product between query and training camera ray directions
compute_sample_rgb_features: sample RGB values and deep features from training images at projected 3D point locations
normalize_pixel_locations: normalize pixel coordinates to the range [-1, 1] for use with grid sampling operations
inbound_check_pixel_validity: check if pixel locations fall within valid image boundaries and return a boolean mask
